parrafo_1.es: Gomez Ceramic Tiles es una tienda e instalacion de azulejo en Orlando. En su showroom de N Forsyth Rd eliges el material, y el mismo equipo que lo vende lo instala: sin intermediarios ni subcontratistas sorpresa.
parrafo_1.en: Gomez Ceramic Tiles is a tile store and installation crew in Orlando. You pick the material in their N Forsyth Rd showroom, and the same team that sells it installs it: no middlemen or surprise subcontractors.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes que llevan mas de 15 años volviendo dicen lo mismo: precios claros, atencion directa de Roger y Yamaris, y un acabado que no deja nada a medias.
parrafo_2.en: Clients who have come back for over 15 years say the same thing: clear pricing, direct attention from Roger and Yamaris, and a finish that leaves nothing half done.

items.quote: Mr Gomez of Gomez Ceramic Tiles did an outstanding job with the remodel of my secondary bathroom. What stood out the most with me was how effectively they communicated.
Roger & Yamaris were fantastic to work with during our bathroom remodels. Their customer service was top notch and they took care of things like it was their own home.
I have been a customer of Gomez Tiles for the past 15+ years. Their product and pricing are of excellent value along with super service.
